translationRepairs: The Late Emperor's father is posthumously honored as Emperor Wen, temple name Taizu;
The emperor's late father was posthumously honored as Emperor Wen, with the temple name Taizu;

皇考 means the reigning emperor’s own deceased father, not “the Late Emperor’s father” (which implies the father of a deceased emperor). The literal field has the same error (“the Late Emperor’s father”).
The Late Emperor's mother as Empress Xian.
His late mother as Empress Xian.
皇妣 means the emperor’s own deceased mother; “The Late Emperor’s mother” wrongly implies the mother of a deceased emperor. (Idiomatic “and his mother” is acceptable.)
Four hundred years have passed since Han Wendi—how distant that seems.
Han Wendi’s mere four hundred criminal cases a year—how remote that age now seems.
漢文四百 alludes to the four hundred criminal judgments a year under Emperor Wen of Han (a byword for light punishment), not to four hundred years elapsed; the literal field repeats the error.
The newly dismissed Duke of Xiemu county Xiao Baoyi was made Prince of Baling to maintain Qi ancestral rites.
The newly appointed Duke of Xiemu county Xiao Baoyi was made Prince of Baling to maintain Qi ancestral rites.
新除 means “newly appointed”, not “newly dismissed”; the literal field has the same error.
Xie Tiao was appointed Left Supernumerary Grand Master with full ministerial honors; He Yin became Right Supernumerary Grand Master.
Xie Fei was summoned as Left Supernumerary Grand Master with full ministerial honors; He Yin became Right Supernumerary Grand Master.
謝朏 is Xie Fei (朏 fěi), not the poet Xie Tiao (謝朓), and 徵 means he was summoned to court; the literal field also misreads the name as Xie Tiao.
On wuzi day Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi rebelled with an army. Staff Officer of the Army Wang Mao was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector and sent to crush him.
On wuzi day Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi rebelled with an army. General Who Leads the Army Wang Mao was made General Who Conquers the South and Jiangzhou inspector and led troops to crush him.
領軍將軍 is General Who Leads the Army (as in s0064), not “Staff Officer of the Army”, and 征南將軍 is General Who Conquers the South (as in s0080); the literal field has the same office errors.
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Acting North Qinzhou inspector Yang Shaoixian became North Qinzhou inspector and Prince of Wudu.
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Acting North Qinzhou inspector Yang Shaoxian became North Qinzhou inspector and Prince of Wudu.
楊紹先 is romanized Yang Shaoxian; “Shaoixian” is a typographical corruption, repeated in the literal field.
On day renchen, Jiaozhou inspector Li Kai rebelled and held the province; chief clerk Li Di crushed him.
On day renchen, Jiaozhou inspector Li Kai rebelled and held the province; chief clerk Li Ce crushed him.
李畟 is Li Ce (畟 cè), not “Li Di”; the literal field repeats the misreading.
Former general Prince of Poyang Hui was made South Xuzhou inspector;
General of the Front, the Prince of Poyang Hui, was made South Xuzhou inspector;
前將軍 is the title General of the Front, not “former general”; the literal field has the same error (“Former General”).
The newly dismissed Left Supernumerary Grand Master Xie Tiao was made Minister of Works and Director of the Masters of Writing.
The newly appointed Left Supernumerary Grand Master Xie Fei was made Minister over the Masses and Director of the Masters of Writing.
新除 means newly appointed, not dismissed; 謝朏 is Xie Fei, not Xie Tiao (謝朓); 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Works (司空). The literal field has the same three errors.
In the eleventh month, on yimao day, thunder, lightning, and heavy rain fell on the month's last day.
In the eleventh month, on yimao day, there was thunder, lightning, and heavy rain, and the sky turned dark.
晦 here describes the sky darkening; yimao fell early in the eleventh month of Tianjian 2 (about 10 December 503), not on the last day of the month. The literal field has the same reading.

On guichou day Right Vice Director Wang Ying became Left Vice Director; Crown Prince tutor Liu Tan became Right Vice Director; and former Left Vice Director Shen Yue was made General Who Pacifies the Army.

On guichou day Right Vice Director Wang Ying became Left Vice Director; Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household Liu Tan became Right Vice Director; and former Left Vice Director Shen Yue was made General Who Stabilizes the Army.
太子詹事 is the Supervisor of the Crown Prince’s Household, not a tutor; 鎮軍將軍 is General Who Stabilizes the Army (as in s0064), not “Pacifies”. The literal field has the same errors.
In the fifth month, on dingsi day, King of Funan Jiao Chen Ru Jian Ye Ba Mo was made General Who Pacifies the South.
In the fifth month, on dingsi day, the King of Funan, Kaundinya Jayavarman (Jiaochenru Sheyebamo), was made General Who Pacifies the South.
憍陳如闍耶跋摩 transcribes Kaundinya Jayavarman; 闍 is read she (or du), so “Jian Ye Ba Mo” misreads the name. The literal field has the same misreading.
In the ninth month, on renzi day, Heir of the Prince of Henan Fu Lianchou became General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of West Qin and He, and Prince of Henan.
In the ninth month, on renzi day, Fu Lianchou, heir of the Prince of Henan, became General Who Guards the West, inspector of West Qin and He, and Prince of Henan.
鎮西將軍 is General Who Guards the West (as in s0075 and s0077), not “Pacifies the West” (安西); the literal field has the same error.

In winter, tenth month, day bingwu, the Northern Campaign opened; Central Army General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong took overall command of the northern expedition, with Right Vice Director Liu Yan as his deputy.

In winter, tenth month, day bingwu, the Northern Campaign opened; Central Army General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong took overall command of the northern expedition, with Right Vice Director Liu Tan as his deputy.
柳惔 is Liu Tan (惔 tán), already so rendered in s0177; “Liu Yan” misreads the name, and the literal field repeats the error.
In the twelfth month, Chancellor of State and Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Tiao left office to mourn his birth mother.
In the twelfth month, Minister over the Masses and Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Fei left office to mourn his birth mother.
謝朏 is Xie Fei, not Xie Tiao (謝朓); 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Chancellor of State (相國). The literal field has the same errors.

On day yihai, former chancellor Xie Tiao was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, Chancellor of State, and Guard General; Pacification Army General Shen Yue became Right Grandee for Splendid Merit; and Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made South Xuzhou inspector.

On day yihai, former Minister over the Masses Xie Fei was made Director of the Secretariat, Minister over the Masses, and General of the Guard; General Who Stabilizes the Army Shen Yue became Right Grandee for Splendid Merit; and Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made South Xuzhou inspector.

謝朏 is Xie Fei; 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Chancellor of State; 中書監 is Director of the Secretariat; 鎮軍將軍 is General Who Stabilizes the Army (s0064). The literal field has the same name and office errors.
In the fifth month, on day xinwei, Left Guard of the Crown Prince Zhang Huishao took Wei Suzhou city.
In the fifth month, on day xinwei, Left Guard Commander of the Crown Prince Zhang Huishao took the Wei city of Suyu.
宿預 is Suyu, not “Suzhou”; 太子左衛率 is the commander of the crown prince’s left guard. The literal field also has “Suzhou”.
On day xinyou, work on the Crown Prince's palace was completed.
On day xinyou, the Crown Prince's palace was built.
作太子宮 records the building of the crown prince’s palace; “work … was completed” adds a completion not in the source (the literal field is accurate).
In the twelfth month, on day guimao, Chancellor of State Xie Tiao died.
In the twelfth month, on day guimao, Minister over the Masses Xie Fei died.
謝朏 is Xie Fei and 司徒 is Minister over the Masses; the literal field has the same errors (Xie Tiao, Chancellor of State).

In the sixth month, on day gengxu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou inspector Xiahou Xiang was made Right Grandee for Splendid Merit, and newly appointed Grandee for Splendid Merit with the Golden Seal and Purple Tassel Liu Yan was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou inspector.

In the sixth month, on day gengxu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou inspector Xiahou Xiang was made Right Grandee for Splendid Merit, and newly appointed Grandee for Splendid Merit with the Golden Seal and Purple Tassel Liu Tan was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou inspector.
柳惔 is Liu Tan (惔 tán), as in s0177; “Liu Yan” misreads the name, and the literal field repeats it.

In the intercalary month, on day yichou, Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Chancellor of State and Acting Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Left Vice Director Shen Yue became Director of the Masters of Writing and Acting Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Ang became Right Vice Director.

In the intercalary month, on day yichou, Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Minister over the Masses and Acting Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Left Vice Director Shen Yue became Director of the Masters of Writing and Acting Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Ang became Right Vice Director.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Chancellor of State (相國); the literal field has the same error.
On day yichou, Wei Huaiyang garrison commander Chang Yinhe surrendered the city.
On day yichou, Chang Yonghe, commander-in-chief of the Wei garrison at Huaiyang, surrendered the city to Liang.
常邕和 is Chang Yonghe (邕 yōng), not “Yinhe”; 都軍主 is the garrison commander-in-chief. The literal field has the same misreading.

On yihai day, Gao Yun, King of Gaoli and Chariots and Cavalry Grand General, was made General Who Pacifies the East with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity; Lu Sengzhen, General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of South Yanzhou, became Commandant-of-the-Guard.

On yihai day, Gao Yun, King of Goguryeo (Gaoli) and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, was made Grand General Who Soothes the East with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies; Lü Sengzhen, General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of South Yanzhou, became General Who Leads the Army.
撫東大將軍 is Grand General Who Soothes the East (not “Pacifies”, which renders 平); 領軍將軍 is General Who Leads the Army; 呂 is Lü. The literal field shares the title errors.

On bingzi day, Changsha Prince Shen Ye, Central Guard Army, was made inspector of South Yanzhou; Xiao Jing, who also held the commandant's post, became inspector of Yongzhou; and Liu Qingyuan, inspector of Yongzhou, was made Guard Army General.

On bingzi day, Central Army Protector Shenye, Prince of Changsha, was made inspector of South Yanzhou; Xiao Jing, concurrent General Who Leads the Army, became inspector of Yongzhou; and Liu Qingyuan, inspector of Yongzhou, was made General Who Protects the Army.
中護軍 is Central Army Protector, not “Central Guard Army”; 護軍將軍 is General Who Protects the Army; 深業 is one given name (Shenye). The literal field shares these errors.

On guimao day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou; Prince of Shixing Dan, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, was made Guard Army General; and Cao Jingzong, Central Guard General, became General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

On guimao day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, became General Who Quells the West and inspector of Jingzhou; Prince of Shixing Dan, General Who Secures the West and inspector of Jingzhou, was made General Who Protects the Army; and Cao Jingzong, Central Guard General, became General Who Secures the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

The translation renders both 平西 and 安西 as “Pacifies the West”, merging different ranks (cf. s0330: 平西 → 安西 is a promotion); 安南 likewise is Secures the South, and 護軍將軍 is General Who Protects the Army. The literal field shares these errors.

In the ninth month, on dinghai day, an edict said: "Fodder must be gathered from the wild—King Wen of Zhou left us that rule; even pheasant and hare were subject to law—Jiang Xuan was rebuked for forgetting it.

In the ninth month, on dinghai day, an edict said: "Fodder-gatherers must be allowed to go in—King Wen of Zhou left that rule; making the taking of pheasants and hares a crime brought King Xuan of Qi (Jiang Xuan) condemnation.

Allusion to Mencius 1B.2: King Wen opened his park to fodder-gatherers and hunters, while King Xuan of Qi punished killing game in his park. The draft misreads 芻牧必往 as gathering fodder from the wild and makes “Jiang Xuan” forget a rule; the literal field is similarly opaque.
On renchen day, Cheng Jingjun, aide of Wei's East Garrison, beheaded Yan Zhongbao, commander of Suyu, and surrendered the city.
On renchen day, Cheng Jingjun, an adjutant on the staff of the Wei General Who Guards the East, beheaded Yan Zhongbao, commander of Suyu city, and surrendered the city to Liang.
鎮東參軍 is an adjutant (參軍) to the General Who Guards the East (鎮東將軍), not an aide of an “East Garrison”; the literal field has the same error.
In the fourth month of summer, South Liangzhou was established from the northern part of Ba-West Brazil commandery.
In the fourth month of summer, South Liangzhou was established from North Baxi commandery.
巴西 is the commandery name Baxi (“west of Ba”); “Ba-West Brazil” is a mistranslation, and 北巴西郡 is North Baxi commandery, not “the northern part” of it. The literal field shares the error.
On dingmao day, Li Guoxing, commander of Wei's King of Chu city, surrendered.
On dingmao day, Li Guoxing, Wei commander of Chuwang City, surrendered his city to Liang.
楚王城 is a place name (Chuwang City); “Wei's King of Chu city” treats it as a royal title. The literal field has the same error.

In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, Prince of Shixing Dan, Central Army General, was made General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of South Yanzhou; and Changsha Prince Shen Ye, inspector of South Yanzhou, was made Guard Army General.

In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, Prince of Shixing Dan, Central Army General, was made General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of South Yanzhou; and Shenye, Prince of Changsha, inspector of South Yanzhou, was made General Who Protects the Army.
深業 is one given name (Shenye), and 護軍將軍 is General Who Protects the Army, not “Guard Army General”; the literal field shares both errors. (The text writes 慎 for 憺 here.)
In the intercalary month, on jichou day, Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing county; Cai Bun, the administrator, suppressed them.
In the intercalary month, on jichou day, Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing county; Cai Zun, the administrator, suppressed them.
蔡撙 is Cai Zun (撙 zǔn); “Cai Bun” is a misreading, repeated in the literal field.

On guimao day, Zhang Ji, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; and Prince of Poyang Hui, inspector of Yingzhou, was made Guard Army General.

On guimao day, Zhang Ji, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Secures the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; and Prince of Poyang Hui, inspector of Yingzhou, was made General Who Protects the Army.
安北將軍 is General Who Secures the North (平北 is “Pacifies”), and 護軍將軍 is General Who Protects the Army; the literal field shares both errors.
Wang Yan, Left People Minister, was made Minister of Personnel.
Wang Jian, Minister of the Left Census Bureau, was made Minister of Personnel.
王暕 is Wang Jian (暕 jiǎn), not “Wang Yan”; 左民尚書 is the Minister of the Left Census Bureau. The literal field has the same misreading.

In the third month, on xinchou day, bandits killed Deng Ti, administrator of Dongguan and Langye; they used Qushan to bring in Wei forces, and the court sent Quake-Distant General Ma Xiancai to suppress them.

In the third month, on xinchou day, bandits killed Deng Zhe, administrator of Dongguan and Langye; they used Qushan to bring in Wei forces, and the court sent Ma Xianpin, General Who Shakes the Distant, to suppress them.
鄧晣 is Deng Zhe (晣 zhé), not “Deng Ti”, and 馬仙琕 is Ma Xianpin (琕 pín), not “Ma Xiancai”; the literal field repeats both misreadings.
On dingchou day, Lu Sengzhen, Commandant-of-the-Guard, died.
On dingchou day, Lü Sengzhen, General Who Leads the Army, died.
呂 is Lü, and 領軍 abbreviates 領軍將軍, General Who Leads the Army, not “Commandant-of-the-Guard”; the literal field has the same errors.
Thus the martial canopy stood idle with no memorial like Ji Gong's; the red steps lay empty with no footfall like Zheng Sheng's.
Thus the martial canopy stood idle, with no memorial like Lord Ji’s (Ji An), and the red steps lay open in vain, lacking the footfall of Master Zheng (Zheng Chong).

汲公 is Ji An, whose memorials Emperor Wu of Han received at the martial canopy, and 鄭生之履 recalls Zheng Chong, whose footsteps Emperor Ai recognized; the draft (and literal field) leave them as “Ji Gong” and “Zheng Sheng”.
On gengchen day, Ma Xiancai routed the Wei army, took more than one hundred thousand heads, and recovered Qushan city.
On gengchen day, Ma Xianpin routed the Wei army, took more than one hundred thousand heads, and recovered Qushan city.
馬仙琕 is Ma Xianpin (琕 pín), not “Ma Xiancai”; the literal field repeats the misreading.

Shen Yue, Left Grand Master for Splendor and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor, received Special Advance; Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, was granted third-rank ceremonial parity; Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Grand Commander; Wang Mao, Fast Cavalry General, became Minister of Works; Wang Ying, Masters of Writing Director and Cloud-Banner General, was promoted to Pacification Left General; and Zhang Ji, General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was promoted to General Who Garrisons the North.

Shen Yue, Left Grand Master for Splendor and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor, received Special Advance; Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, was granted ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies; Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Grand Commandant; Wang Mao, General of Agile Cavalry, became Minister of Works; Wang Ying, Masters of Writing Director and Cloud-Banner General, was promoted to General Who Secures the Left; and Zhang Ji, General Who Secures the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was promoted to General Who Garrisons the North.

太尉 is Grand Commandant (not “Grand Commander”), 安左將軍 is General Who Secures the Left, 安北將軍 is General Who Secures the North, and 儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not a “third rank”; the literal field shares these errors.
In the sixth month, on xinsi day, Wang Mao, Minister of Works, was also made Central Army General.
In the sixth month, on xinsi day, Wang Mao, Minister of Works, was also made Central Power General.
中權將軍 is Central Power General (see s0287), not “Central Army General” (中軍將軍); the literal field has the same error.

In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, became Central Guard General; and Prince of Poyang Hui, Guard Army General, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou.

In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Secures the West and inspector of Jingzhou, became Central Guard General; and Prince of Poyang Hui, General Who Protects the Army, became General Who Quells the West and inspector of Jingzhou.
The draft renders both 安西 and 平西 as “Pacifies the West”, merging two different ranks; 護軍將軍 is General Who Protects the Army. The literal field shares these errors.

In the ninth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity and inspector of Jiangzhou, became Pacification Army General, his ceremonial parity unchanged;

In the ninth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies and inspector of Jiangzhou, became General Who Soothes the Army, keeping his ceremonial parity;
儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies (三司), not a “third-rank” parity; the literal field repeats the error.
and Wang Mao, who also held the Central Army Generalship, became Fast Cavalry General with open office equal-to-third-rank protocol and inspector of Jiangzhou.
and Wang Mao, concurrent Central Power General, became General of Agile Cavalry with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies and inspector of Jiangzhou.
領中權將軍 is concurrent Central Power General, not “Central Army Generalship”; 同三司之儀 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third rank”. The literal field has the same errors.
On bingyin day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, Aide Right General, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou.
On bingyin day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Assists the Right, became General Who Secures the West and inspector of Yingzhou.
安西將軍 is General Who Secures the West; the draft uses “Pacifies the West”, which it also uses for 平西 in s0440. The literal field has the same rendering.
In the second month, on dinghai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field in person, pardoned the realm, and granted one rank of nobility to the filial, the incorrupt, and the diligent farmers.
In the second month, on dinghai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field in person, pardoned the realm, and granted one rank of nobility to the filial and fraternal and to diligent farmers.
孝悌力田 means the filial and fraternal (悌) and diligent farmers; “incorrupt” mistranslates 悌. The literal field has the same error.
In the third month, on xinhai day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, newly made Pacification Central General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, became Left Grand Master for Splendor.

In the third month, on xinhai day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, newly appointed Central Soothing General with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies, became Left Grand Master for Splendor.
儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank”; 中撫將軍 is Central Soothing General. The literal field has the same error.
In the fifth month, on xinhai day, Wei Rui, Regular Attendant of Direct Transmission and Regular Palatial Cavalier, became Central Guard General.
In the fifth month, on xinhai day, Wei Rui, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary with Direct Access, became Central Army Protector.
通直散騎常侍 is a single office (Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary with Direct Access), not two; 中護軍 is Central Army Protector, not “Central Guard General” (中衛將軍). The literal field shares both errors.
On bingwu day, Wang Ying, Pacification Left General and Director of the Masters of Writing, was advanced in title to Central Army General.
On bingwu day, Wang Ying, General Who Secures the Left and Director of the Masters of Writing, was advanced in title to Central Power General.
中權將軍 is Central Power General, not “Central Army General” (中軍將軍); 安左將軍 is General Who Secures the Left. The literal field has the same errors.

On xinchou day, Wei Rui, Central Guard General, became General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Yongzhou; and Prince of Shixing Dan, newly made Pacification Central General, became inspector of Jingzhou.

On xinchou day, Wei Rui, Central Army Protector, became General Who Quells the North and inspector of Yongzhou; and Prince of Shixing Dan, newly appointed Central Soothing General, became inspector of Jingzhou.
中護軍 is Central Army Protector, not “Central Guard General” (中衛將軍); 平北將軍 is General Who Quells the North. The literal field has the same errors.
In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou day, Wang Mao, Fast Cavalry General with open office equal-to-third-rank protocol and inspector of Jiangzhou, died.
In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou day, Wang Mao, General of Agile Cavalry with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies and inspector of Jiangzhou, died.
同三司之儀 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank protocol”; the literal field repeats the error.

In the fifth month, on guiwei day, Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, became Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; his titles as Fast Cavalry Grand General and inspector remained unchanged.

In the fifth month, on guiwei day, Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, became Supervisor of the Secretariat, keeping his posts as Grand General of Agile Cavalry and inspector.
中書監 is Supervisor of the Secretariat (中書), not of the Masters of Writing (尚書); the literal field has the same error.

On gengzi day, Wang Ying, Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Grand Master for Splendor with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity; Yuan Ang, Right Vice Director, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Wang Yan, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

On gengzi day, Wang Ying, Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Grand Master for Splendor with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies; Yuan Ang, Right Vice Director, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Wang Jian, Minister of Personnel, became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
王暕 is Wang Jian (暕 jiǎn), not “Wang Yan”; 儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank”. The literal field has both errors.
In the ninth month, on xinsi day, Wang Ying, Left Grand Master for Splendor with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, died.
In the ninth month, on xinsi day, Wang Ying, Left Grand Master for Splendor with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies, died.
開府儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank”; the literal field repeats the error.
Li Bi, inspector of Jiaozhou, executed the rebel Ruan Zongxiao and sent his head to the capital.
Li Ce, inspector of Jiaozhou, executed the Jiaozhou rebel Ruan Zongxiao and sent his head to the capital.
李畟 is Li Ce (畟 cè), not “Li Bi”; the literal field repeats the misreading.
In the sixth month, on wushen day, Prince of Luling Ji became inspector of Jiangzhou.
In the sixth month, on wushen day, the Prince of Luling (Xiao Xu; the text writes 績 for 續) became inspector of Jiangzhou.
The Prince of Luling was Xiao Xu 蕭續; 績 (Ji) belongs to the Prince of Nankang (s0528), so “Prince of Luling Ji” conflates two sons of Emperor Wu. The literal field has the same reading.
In the second month, on guisi day, General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu died.
In the second month, on guisi day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of Yongzhou, died.
鎮北將軍 is General Who Garrisons the North (as s0506 has it), not “Pacifies the North”; the literal field has the same error.
Xiao Jing, Commandant-of-the-Guards, was made Pacification Right General and overseer of Yangzhou.
Xiao Jing, General Who Leads the Army, was made General Who Secures the Right and Overseer of Yangzhou.
領軍將軍 is General Who Leads the Army and 安右將軍 General Who Secures the Right; “Commandant-of-the-Guards” and “Pacification Right General” are loose. The literal field has the same renderings.
On guimao day, Cai Zuan, Imperial Academy Rector, was made Minister of Personnel.
On guimao day, Cai Zun, Libationer of the Imperial Academy, was made Minister of Personnel.
蔡撙 is Cai Zun (撙 zǔn), as in s0378, not “Cai Zuan”; the literal field repeats the misreading.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Prince of Nanping Wei was made Left Grandee for Splendid Merit with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Prince of Nanping Wei was made Left Grandee for Splendid Merit with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies.
開府儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank ceremonial parity”; the literal field repeats the error.

In the eighteenth year, on jiashen day of the first month of spring, Commandant-of-the-Guards Prince of Poyang Hui was made General Who Pacifies the West with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and inspector of Jingzhou; and Jingzhou inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made Central Pacification General with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and Commandant-of-the-Guards.

In the eighteenth year, on jiashen day of the first month of spring, Prince of Poyang Hui, General Who Leads the Army, was made General Who Conquers the West with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies and inspector of Jingzhou; and Jingzhou inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made Central Soothing General with an open office and ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies, concurrently leading the army.

征西將軍 is General Who Conquers the West (not “Pacifies”, which renders 平/安); 儀同三司 is parity with the Three Excellencies, not “third-rank”; 領軍 is leadership of the army. The literal field shares these errors.
